example.title: Fire Barn No. 5, 533 Saint Charles Street

brief: Two-storey neighbourhood fire station of about 1904: buff brick with red-brick quoins and trim, a pair of big red engine doors under round arches, a bracketed cornice, and a hipped roof crowned by a square hose-drying cupola; the police substation shares the side door. A bell mounted on a brick base out front.
